title: LIVECLOSE Harness Evidence
description: Machine-readable evidence contract for Phase 11.1 LIVECLOSE carry-in closure harnesses (LIVECLOSE-01..05). Every harness in scripts/closure/ MUST emit evidence files conforming to this schema via scripts.closure._common.write_evidence(). Closed for extension after Phase 11.1 Plan 01; Wave 2 plans (11.1-02..06) consume read-only. schema_version is pinned to 1; additionalProperties is true so individual harnesses may add payload keys (ci_url, verdict, row_count, etc.) without bumping schema_version.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Bump only on a breaking change to the required-field set or to the status enum.

status.description: Harness outcome. COMPLETE = harness ran and emitted all evidence. AWAITING_HUMAN = harness ran successfully but a wall-clock operator action is still required to close the carry-in. INSUFFICIENT_DATA = harness ran but the input data is below the closure threshold (e.g. <7 PSR-CI rows for LIVECLOSE-03). FAILED = harness errored before emitting full evidence.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the harness wrote this evidence file.

evidence_paths.description: Repo-relative paths to the human-readable evidence artifacts (markdown, screenshots, log captures, CSVs). Empty list permitted for FAILED runs that never produced any artifact.

human_needed.description: True when a wall-clock operator action is still required AFTER the harness ran (e.g. LIVE-flip smoke, GitHub-Actions billing recovery). The LIVECLOSE-INDEX.md table surfaces this flag to operators.

liveclose_id.description: Which Phase 11 carry-in this evidence file closes (or partially closes, when human_needed=true).
